svg.title: Banneret — passive tree
svg.desc: The party wheel as a passive tree, one sector per hero. Each hero has four class branches starting at his portrait. The inner ring holds class nodes open to any hero of that precursor, each branch capped with a keystone that turns the hero into that class. The middle ring holds class and ascended passives open to that class, capped with three ascended keystones. The outer ring holds ascended-only nodes. Nodes are colour-coded by class. Sample mid-run: the warrior is a Paladin and Martyr with a few Berserker nodes, the caster is a Wizard, the skirmisher has no class yet. Class names, node counts and what is bought are illustrative. Static SVG mockup.
svg.text: LAYOUT TEST · mid-run sample. Class names, node counts and what is bought are illustrative.
Keystone taken: the hero is that class
Inner ring: class nodes, open to any hero of that precursor, capped with the class keystone. Four classes per hero.
Middle ring: class and ascended passives, open to that class, capped with three ascended keystones. Outer ring: ascended-only nodes. Node colour = class.
